title: Explore the line y = m·x + c
instructions: Move the sliders to change the slope m and the y-intercept c. Watch how the line tilts and shifts. Try (m, c) = (1, 0) for the line y = x; (m, c) = (2, 1) for y = 2x + 1; (m, c) = (0, 3) for the horizontal line y = 3. Every linear equation in two variables corresponds to such a line.
